youtube.baslik: Can your ear's protective reflex beat a gunshot? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: A loud sound makes the stapedius muscle contract in both ears, giving the inner ear some protection against strong, long-lasting low-frequency sounds. But the reflex works with a delay, so it cannot catch the first instant of a sudden blast like a gunshot.
